Colin McRae Rally.name: Colin McRae Rally
Colin McRae Rally.summary: Colin McRae Rally is the first entry in the Colin McRae Rally franchise. The game features twelve different laser modeled vehicles in which players can compete against the clock and your rivals over fifty unique stages from eight different countries.

Flamberge no Seirei.name: Flamberge no Seirei
Flamberge no Seirei.summary: Flamberge no Seirei is an Adventure game, developed and published by Kid, which was released in Japan in 2000.

Lion and the King 2.name: Lion and the King 2
Lion and the King 2.summary: Another movie/mini-game combo from Dingo Pictures, Phoenix Games, and The Code Monkeys.

Raiden DX.name: Raiden DX
Raiden DX.summary: Vertical scrolling shoot-em-up that adds new features to its prequel Raiden II. Choose from three separate missions: Training special stage, Alpha levels 1-5 and Bravo levels 1-9. Collect various power-ups to increase your weaponry. Lots of secrets and bonuses including ratings based upon player performance

SuperLite 1500 Series - NumCro 4.name: SuperLite 1500 Series: Nankuro 4
SuperLite 1500 Series - NumCro 4.summary:
A crossword is a word puzzle that normally takes the form of a square or rectangular grid of white and shaded squares. The goal is to fill the white squares with letters, forming words or phrases, by solving clues which lead to the answers. In languages that are written left-to-right, the answer words and phrases are placed in the grid from left to right and from top to bottom. The shaded squares are used to separate the words or phrases.

Squares in which answers begin are usually numbered. The clues are then referred to by these numbers and a direction, for example, "4-Across" or "20-Down". At the end of the clue the total number of letters is sometimes given, depending on the style of puzzle and country of publication. Some crosswords will also indicate the number of words in a given answer, should there be more than one.
